criteria.name: CPL split from capture time
criteria.claim: Within each of the 9 shutter-speed groups, ordered by SubSecDateTimeOriginal, there is exactly one interior gap greater than 10x the group median gap, and it falls after index 19 -- i.e. 20 frames, an intermission, 20 frames.
criteria.statistic: max interior inter-frame gap / median inter-frame gap, and the index it falls after
criteria.threshold: ratio >= 10 and index == 19, in all 9 of 9 groups
criteria.fail_input_exists: A group shot straight through would give ratio ~1. A 25/15 split would give index 24. Both are inside the estimator's range.
criteria.consequence: If it fails in any group the split is not recoverable from time alone and the milestone STOPS and reports.
criteria.status_at_write_time: ALREADY RUN on metadata only, in 00-exif-census.py. MET 9/9: gaps 277.4-284.5 s against medians 1.003-1.061 s (ratio 262-283x), index 19 every time.

criteria.name: CPL split cross-checked against signal level
criteria.claim: The first 20 frames of every group are the CPL-on half, so they are darker than the last 20 at matched shutter speed by the 1.5-2 stops a circular polariser costs.
criteria.statistic: R_k = mean(black-subtracted G1 spatial mean, frames 0..19) / mean(same, frames 20..39), per exposure group k
criteria.threshold: R_k < 1 in ALL 9 groups without exception, and 0.20 <= R_k <= 0.45 (1.15 to 2.32 stops) in every group where neither half has a clipped pixel fraction > 0.01%
criteria.fail_input_exists: If the owner shot no-CPL first, R_k > 1. If the level difference were illumination drift rather than the filter, R_k would be within a few percent of 1. Both are reachable numbers.
criteria.consequence: Brief instruction is explicit: if time-ordering and signal level disagree, STOP AND REPORT. No CPL-split analysis is run.

criteria.name: Focus state of the 360 flats
criteria.claim: EXIF says FocusDistance2 = inf and FocusPosition2 = 255 for all 360 flats, against 0.2707-0.2771 m and 56-58 for the two sweeps. PREDICTION, registered before pixels: the flats were shot racked to infinity with the paper at 0.28 m, so their resolved paper texture is BELOW the least-focused frame of either sweep.
criteria.statistic: X(frame) = cov(r_G1, r_G2) on a single frame, where r_P = P / gaussian_blur(P, sigma_s) - 1. Shot noise and PRNU are independent between G1 and G2, so X estimates the COMMON optical structure alone.
criteria.threshold: X(flats, 1/5 s) < min over the 62 frames of BOTH sweeps
criteria.fail_input_exists: If the flats were in focus, X(flat) would land at or near the sweep maximum. If FocusPosition2=255 were a meaningless sentinel and focus was unchanged, X(flat) would land inside the sweep range.
criteria.consequence: If it fails, the paper-texture confound is live in the flats and every kappa from them is reported as an UPPER BOUND, explicitly labelled, not as a measurement.

criteria.name: The defocus lever has range
criteria.claim: The sweeps genuinely span focus, so they can calibrate how much paper texture defocus removes.
criteria.statistic: max(X) / min(X) over the 62 frames of a sweep
criteria.fail_input_exists: A sweep that never reached focus would give ~1x.
criteria.consequence: If it fails the defocus lever is dead and the spectral lever must carry the separation alone; say so.

criteria.name: PTC reproduces the shipped gain
criteria.claim: A temporal photon-transfer curve on 9 levels spanning 50x at fixed ISO 100 reproduces profile.rs's g = 0.2289377 DN/e-.
criteria.statistic: slope a of a weighted least-squares fit of V(S) = a*S + b, where V is the mean over unmasked pixels of the per-pixel temporal variance across the 20 frames of a group, each frame first divided by its own spatial mean (mandatory drift normalisation), and S is the black-subtracted spatial mean of the temporal mean map
criteria.threshold: |a / 0.2289377 - 1| <= 0.10 for the claim 'this PTC reproduces the shipped model' to be made at all. 10% is the corpus's own tolerance: fact 585 licensed a -10.7% PTC-vs-relation discrepancy at ISO 160 to stand.
criteria.fail_input_exists: Fact 585's own -10.7% is outside this band, so a failing value is not merely reachable, it has already been observed once on this camera.
criteria.consequence: Failure is REPORTED AS A CONTRADICTION with the profile, not reinterpreted. No reproduction is claimed.

criteria.name: Two-greens null on the PTC
criteria.claim: G1 and G2 are two independent photosite populations under the same optical field, so their fitted gains must agree.
criteria.statistic: a(G2) / a(G1), with its standard error from the fit
criteria.threshold: within 3 standard errors of 1.000. M68's precedent value for the analogous null is 0.99937 +- 0.00511.
criteria.fail_input_exists: A plane-indexing bug, a CFA phase error, or a row/column artefact would all move this off 1.
criteria.consequence: If it fails the estimator is broken, not the sensor. Everything downstream of it is withdrawn.

criteria.name: The temporal PTC must NOT be quadratic
criteria.claim: Per-pixel TEMPORAL variance cannot contain PRNU or paper texture, because both are fixed across the 20 frames. So a quadratic term in the temporal PTC is not PRNU -- it is residual illumination instability, and it contaminates a.
criteria.statistic: c from V = a*S + b + c*S^2, and sqrt(c) as an equivalent relative sigma
criteria.threshold: sqrt(c) consistent with zero at 3 sigma. If not, report sqrt(c) as the residual drift amplitude and refit a with the quadratic term present.
criteria.fail_input_exists: 9 minutes of Seattle overcast with moving cloud is exactly the condition that produces c > 0; the owner flagged it himself.
criteria.consequence: Reported either way. A clean null is a stated result.

criteria.name: kappa is multiplicative
criteria.claim: PRNU is a gain non-uniformity, so the ABSOLUTE fixed-pattern sd must scale linearly with signal. This is the defining signature and it separates PRNU from additive offset FPN.
criteria.statistic: exponent q of a power-law fit sd_fixed(S) = A * S^q over the exposure levels of one CPL state
criteria.fail_input_exists: Offset FPN gives q = 0. A mixture gives q between. Both reachable.
criteria.consequence: If q is not 1, (kappa*S)^2 is the WRONG FUNCTIONAL FORM and the ruling says so rather than reporting a kappa.

criteria.name: kappa is sensor-fixed and repeats
criteria.claim: The PRNU map recovered from the CPL-on half must reproduce the map from the CPL-off half: different time, different filter, same sensor.
criteria.statistic: Pearson rho between the two recovered per-pixel PRNU maps, computed on the highest unclipped common exposure
criteria.fail_input_exists: A pattern that is really paper texture would still repeat (the paper did not move), so this is a NECESSARY not sufficient test and is labelled so. A pattern that is really residual noise would give rho ~ 0, which is reachable at these amplitudes.
criteria.consequence: If it fails there is no fixed pattern to model and kappa is reported as an upper bound at the noise floor.

criteria.name: kappa is invariant under defocus -- THE DECISIVE ONE
criteria.claim: Defocus destroys paper texture and leaves sensor PRNU untouched. So the cross-plane-separated PRNU must be the SAME at the sweep's in-focus frames and at its most defocused frames, while the common optical term C moves by >= 10x.
criteria.statistic: P = var(r_G1) - cov(r_G1, r_G2) - noise, per sweep frame; and C = cov(r_G1, r_G2), per sweep frame
criteria.threshold: max(C)/min(C) >= 10 across the sweep AND P at the sharpest frame within +-25% of P at the most defocused frame
criteria.fail_input_exists: If the estimator were actually measuring paper, P would track C and fall by the same 10x through defocus. That is the outcome this gate is built to catch and it is entirely reachable.
criteria.consequence: If P tracks C, the separation has failed, kappa is an upper bound only, and the ruling says the data cannot answer the question.

criteria.name: Placebo and negative control for the separator
criteria.claim: cov(r_G1, r_G2) measures common structure and nothing else.
criteria.statistic: (i) POSITIVE: split one group's 20 frames into two disjoint 10-frame halves, both on G1; cov between the two half-mean residuals must recover the full fixed-pattern variance of G1, since the fixed pattern IS common there. (ii) NEGATIVE: roll r_G2 by an even offset (discipline 397 -- even, to preserve CFA phase) and recompute cov; it must collapse.
criteria.threshold: (i) recovered within +-20% of var(r_G1) - noise. (ii) |cov_rolled| <= 3 standard errors of zero.
criteria.fail_input_exists: A covariance estimator with a normalisation bug fails (i). A shared low-frequency residual from an under-aggressive smooth surface fails (ii).
criteria.consequence: Either failure withdraws the whole separation.

criteria.name: MATERIALITY -- does kappa enter sigma^2(S)?
criteria.claim: kappa enters the model iff it inflates the predicted SIGMA by at least 5% at the mid-tone the corpus's own dust spec names, S = 8000 DN.
criteria.threshold: kappa >= 0.001713 (0.1713%) enters; below that it does not
criteria.fail_input_exists: Fact 230's independent bound is <= 0.26%, which is ABOVE this threshold, so 'it enters' is reachable from the corpus's own prior. A kappa at the 0.05% level is equally reachable. The gate genuinely discriminates.
criteria.consequence: Binding. 'It is negligible and must not be added' is a successful outcome and will be reported as the ruling if the number lands below the line.

criteria.name: Is the CPL spatially flat?
criteria.claim: The circular polariser introduces no spatial non-uniformity of its own.
criteria.statistic: Q = (mu_on / mean mu_on) / (mu_off / mean mu_off), smoothed; its peak-to-peak and its best-fit radial edge-to-centre gradient
criteria.threshold: FLAT iff smoothed peak-to-peak < 1% AND radial gradient < 0.5%
criteria.fail_input_exists: A tilted or stress-birefringent filter, or simple angle-of-incidence dependence of polariser efficiency across a wide cone, all produce a radial term well above 0.5%.
criteria.consequence: If not flat, this is a per-stack systematic on the seven CPL-on corpus stacks (fact 925 authoritative) that nobody has accounted for, and it is reported as such.
criteria.mandatory_placebo: The SAME statistic between two SAME-STATE groups at different times is the illumination-drift null. The CPL claim requires the cross-state Q to exceed the same-state placebo by >= 3x its scatter. Without the placebo the number means nothing, because a moving cloud edge also makes Q non-flat.

criteria.name: Dust map
criteria.claim: Dust shadows are fixed in SENSOR coordinates and visible in every plane and both CPL states.
criteria.statistic: Connected components of pixels where the plane-averaged residual r < -3%, required to be < -1.5% independently in BOTH CPL states and in >= 3 of the 4 planes
criteria.threshold: report count, area fraction, size distribution, deepest shadow. M29's fact 232 recorded real dust at 1-15% depth.
criteria.fail_input_exists: A clean sensor gives zero components, which is a perfectly good result.
criteria.consequence: Reported as a map; no gate hangs on it.
criteria.negative_control: The same detector on a copy rolled by an even offset must find ~0 components (discipline 397).

criteria.name: Did the illumination drift carry SPATIAL structure?
criteria.claim: Global illumination drift is a per-frame scalar and divides out under per-frame mean normalisation. Residual excess temporal variance after that normalisation is evidence the drift carried spatial structure.
criteria.statistic: ratio of the mean per-pixel temporal variance AFTER normalisation to the noise model's prediction, and the same ratio computed on a heavily blurred version of each frame's residual (which suppresses white noise by the kernel's area and so isolates low-frequency drift)
criteria.threshold: no threshold -- REPORTED EITHER WAY. A clean null is worth stating and will be stated.
criteria.fail_input_exists: n/a, this is a measurement not a gate
criteria.consequence: A finding rather than a nuisance, per the brief.

note: Anything not in this list that appears in the report is POST-HOC and will be labelled post-hoc in the report, per M68's form.
